Posted by J. Maverick09-23-26 09:00 AM

Texas law does not require meal or rest breaks for adult employees. Our policy: one 30-minute meal break on every shift over 6 hours. Clock out and back in for your meal break.

Breaks follow company policy in Texas.

Los Angeles, CA / Store 4
Posted by J. Maverick09-23-26 09:00 AM

Take a 30-minute meal break before the end of your 5th hour of work. Take a paid 10-minute rest break for every 4 hours you work. A missed break earns one extra hour of pay.

California law requires meal and rest breaks.
